widgets_values:
Format: H3 Ref2VA.
Duration: 15 seconds.
Aspect ratio: 16:9, full frame.
Pace: natural real-time performance with broken, restrained speech.
Exactly two shots. One straight cut at 7.50s.

Scene:
Manchester harbor footpath, overcast late-autumn afternoon. Damp pavement, a low stone wall on the landward side, gray-blue sea and distant fishing-boat masts. The path recedes toward screen-right depth. Muted cool-gray cinematic realism.

Lighting:
Soft overcast daylight, slightly brighter from the seaward side. Readable eyes, gentle shadows, subtle separation along hair and coat shoulders. Consistent exposure and light direction across the cut.

subject_definitions:
Randi = S1:
Adult woman, oval face, slightly high cheekbones, thin lips, light-brown hair tied low with loose windblown strands. Beige wool short coat, dark-gray knitwear, dark-blue jeans, suede ankle boots, fine silver bracelet on the right wrist.
Voice: soft, breathy adult female voice, mid-high register, slightly unstable breathing, quiet conversational English. No shouting or theatrical crying.

Lee Chandler = S2:
Adult man, narrow long face, defined jaw, slightly deep-set eyes, short stubble, short untidy dark hair. Dark-gray work jacket, worn navy shirt, dark trousers, old brown boots. Slightly rounded upper back.
Voice: low, slightly husky adult male voice, thin grain, breath-heavy, restrained volume. Lee has no spoken dialogue in this segment.

blocking:
Randi stands screen left, Lee screen right, approximately 1.5 meters apart.
All cameras remain on the landward side of their interaction axis.
Randi looks screen right toward Lee. Lee's reciprocal eyeline points screen left.
Lee keeps both hands inside his jacket pockets.
Randi initially keeps both arms at her sides.
Only one face is sharply readable at a time.

detailed_description:

[Shot 1 | 0.00–7.50s]
50mm, f/2.0, waist-up medium close-up of Randi. Static camera, shallow depth of field.
A small, blurred portion of Lee's shoulder may occupy the far-right edge. No second readable face.

0.00–1.50s:
Randi finishes stopping after recognizing Lee.
Her head turns toward Lee first; her upper body follows slightly.
Her lips part as if to greet him, but no word comes.
Randi watches Lee's eyes, then takes a small preparatory breath. Both hands remain down.

1.50–7.20s:
Randi (S1) says, lip-synced:
<d>[English] "The things I said back then... I should go to hell."</d>

The first phrase is an effort to speak normally.
During the first pause, Randi closes her lips and searches Lee's face for a response.
Receiving none, her gaze drops from Lee's eyes to his collar. Her brows draw inward slightly.

Before the final clause, one short inhalation catches. Her upper chest lifts once, without repeated shaking.
Her eyes become moist. She resumes the sentence more quietly.
A brief lower-jaw tremor occurs between words, not throughout the spoken mouth movements.

7.20–7.50s:
Randi finishes, closes her lips and looks back toward Lee's eyes.
Her chin remains slightly raised, waiting for an answer.
Cut because she is waiting for his response.

[Shot 2 | 7.50–15.00s]
Straight reverse cut to Lee.
85mm, f/1.8, close-up from upper chest upward. Static camera.
Randi's shoulder is a soft fragment at the far-left edge. Lee is the only readable face.
Match positions, lighting and the exact end of Randi's sentence.

7.50–9.70s:
Lee looks below Randi's face.
His eyes begin to lift toward her, but stop before sustained eye contact.
After her sentence has ended, his throat moves in one swallow.
He parts his lips and draws a small breath as if preparing to answer, then closes them without speaking.
His shoulders remain drawn inward. No step backward.

9.70–10.40s:
Lee holds the silence.
His gaze stays lowered; his mouth does not form words.

10.40–11.40s:
Randi (S1), off-screen left, says:
<d>[English] "I love you."</d>

On hearing the declaration, Lee's eyes rise to Randi's actual eye position.
His mouth becomes still and his breathing briefly stops.
His brows tighten slightly; no wide-eyed shock.
Hold this brief direct look before he withdraws it.

11.40–12.60s:
Lee breaks eye contact first.
His eyes move down, then his chin follows slightly.
He releases a shallow breath without speaking.

Off-screen, Randi raises her left hand once to waist height, palm angled downward, trying to withdraw her words. Her right hand stays at her side.

12.60–13.60s:
Randi (S1), off-screen left, says:
<d>[English] "I'm sorry..."</d>

Lee hears the apology but does not nod, reassure her or turn away.
The muscles around his mouth tighten only after her words end.

13.60–15.00s:
Randi begins an uneven inhalation off-screen, preparing to continue.
Lee notices her unfinished gesture and lowers his gaze toward her waist-level hand.
His hands remain in his pockets.

Boundary:
End on Lee listening while Randi's inhalation is still in progress.
The next segment immediately reverse-cuts to Randi during this same breath. No elapsed time.

overall_soundscape:
Continuous sea wind, low waves, distant occasional harbor-metal sounds, subtle clothing movement and natural breathing.
Only Randi speaks. Lee's breaths remain nonverbal.
Carry the unfinished inhalation and ambience continuously across the segment boundary.

non_diegetic_music: none.

avoid:
No stroller, bag, additional people or new props.
No subtitles, text, watermark or split screen.
No camera gaze, axis crossing, repeated gestures, slow motion, exaggerated crying, invented dialogue or extra cuts.
